name: gotify-mcp
description: MCP server and CLI for Gotify: send push notifications and manage messages, apps, and clients over stdio or streamable HTTP, with auth.

interface.shortDescription: Send push notifications and manage Gotify apps and clients
interface.longDescription: MCP server bridging Claude to a self-hosted Gotify push notification service. Send alerts with custom priority, list and browse message history, create and manage notification applications and clients, all from Claude or the CLI.
defaultPrompt: Send a notification saying the backup completed successfully.
List recent messages from my Gotify server.
Show all Gotify applications and their priorities.
